en: In the first year of Darius, Daniel understands from Jeremiah's words that Jerusalem's desolation will last seventy years.
Daniel prays with fasting, sackcloth and ashes, confessing his own sin and the sins of his people.
He asks God to hear and forgive, not because of their righteousness, but because of his great compassion.
While Daniel is still praying, Gabriel comes and tells him of seventy weeks decreed for his people and city.
In the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, the LORD stirs Cyrus to proclaim that the LORD's house in Jerusalem must be rebuilt.
Leaders of Judah and Benjamin, priests and Levites get ready to go, and their neighbors give them silver, gold and goods.
Cyrus gives back the temple articles Nebuchadnezzar had taken, 5,400 in all, and Sheshbazzar brings them to Jerusalem.
zh: 大利烏元年，但以理從耶利米的話明白，耶路撒冷荒廢的期限要滿七十年。
但以理禁食，披麻蒙灰禱告，承認自己的罪和百姓的罪。
他求神垂聽、赦免，不是因為他們的義，而是因為神的大憐憫。
但以理還在禱告，加百列就來了，告訴他神為他的百姓和聖城定了七十個七。
波斯王古列元年，耶和華激動古列的心，下令重建耶路撒冷耶和華的殿。
猶大和便雅憫的族長、祭司和利未人起來要上去，四周的人送他們金銀和財物。
古列把尼布甲尼撒從聖殿擄走的器皿交還，共五千四百件，由設巴薩帶回耶路撒冷。

about.en: Jeremiah's promise of return after seventy years
about.zh: 耶利米應許七十年後歸回

about.en: Isaiah names Cyrus, who will say Jerusalem will be rebuilt
about.zh: 以賽亞提到古列，說耶路撒冷必重建

about.en: Chronicles ends with Cyrus's proclamation
about.zh: 歷代志以古列的命令作結

about.en: Nehemiah's prayer of confession, like Daniel's
about.zh: 尼希米認罪的禱告，與但以理相似

en: Cyrus the Great of Persia took Babylon in 539 BC; his decree letting the exiles return is usually dated about 538 BC.
The Cyrus Cylinder, found at Babylon in 1879 and now in the British Museum, records Cyrus returning captive peoples and restoring their shrines.
"Darius the Mede" is known only from Daniel; scholars differ on who he was, and some identify him with Cyrus or one of his officials.
Jerusalem and its temple were destroyed by Babylon in 586 BC; the first exiles had been taken about 605 BC.
zh: 波斯的古列大帝在公元前539年攻取巴比倫；他准許被擄的人歸回的命令，一般定在公元前538年左右。
「古列圓柱」1879年在巴比倫出土，現藏大英博物館，記載古列讓被擄的民族回鄉，並修復他們的神廟。
「米底亞人大利烏」只見於但以理書；學者對他是誰看法不一，有人認為是古列，或是古列手下的官員。
耶路撒冷和聖殿在公元前586年被巴比倫毀滅；第一批人約在公元前605年被擄。

en: In the seventh month the returned exiles rebuild the altar, offer burnt offerings and keep the Festival of Shelters.
When the builders lay the temple's foundation, the priests blow trumpets and the people sing, "He is good; his faithful love lasts forever."
Old men who had seen the first house weep aloud, while many others shout for joy.
Enemies frighten the builders and hire advisers against them, and the work stops until the second year of Darius.
Haggai asks, "Is it a time for you to live in paneled houses, while this house lies in ruins?"
Zerubbabel, Joshua the high priest and the people obey, and begin working on the house of the LORD again.
Darius finds Cyrus's decree, the temple is completed in his sixth year, and the people dedicate it with joy and keep the Passover.
zh: 七月，歸回的人重建祭壇，獻上燔祭，又守住棚節。
工匠立下聖殿的根基時，祭司吹號，眾人歌唱：「他本為善，他向以色列的慈愛永遠長存。」
見過第一座殿的老年人放聲大哭，也有許多人大聲歡呼。
敵人使建造的人害怕，又收買謀士阻撓他們，工程停頓，直到大利烏王第二年。
哈該問：「你們自己住在有木板裝修的房子裏，這殿卻荒涼，這是合宜的時候嗎？」
所羅巴伯、大祭司約書亞和百姓都聽從，重新動工建造耶和華的殿。
大利烏找到古列的諭令，聖殿在他第六年完工；百姓歡歡喜喜地為殿行奉獻禮，又守逾越節。

about.en: The glory of this house will be greater than the former
about.zh: 這殿後來的榮耀必大過先前的

about.en: Zerubbabel will finish the house: not by might, but by my Spirit
about.zh: 所羅巴伯必完成這殿：不是倚靠勢力，乃是靠神的靈

about.en: A song of the LORD restoring Zion's fortunes
about.zh: 耶和華使錫安被擄的人歸回之歌

about.en: Jesus in the temple, rebuilt by Herod over forty-six years
about.zh: 耶穌在希律修建了四十六年的聖殿

en: The foundation was laid about 536 BC; work resumed in 520 BC, the second year of Darius I, and the temple was finished in 515 BC.
Haggai's messages are dated to the months of 520 BC; Ezra 4:8 to 6:18 is written in Aramaic, the official language of the Persian Empire.
Ecbatana, where Cyrus's decree was found, was a Persian royal city; it is modern Hamadan in western Iran.
This second temple stood, later enlarged by Herod the Great, until the Romans destroyed it in AD 70.
zh: 聖殿根基約在公元前536年立下；公元前520年，就是大利烏一世第二年，重新動工，公元前515年完工。
哈該的信息都記有日期，都在公元前520年；以斯拉記4章8節至6章18節用亞蘭文寫成，亞蘭文是波斯帝國的官方語言。
找到古列諭令的亞馬他是波斯的王城，就是今日伊朗西部的哈馬丹。
這第二座聖殿後來由大希律擴建，一直存留，直到公元70年被羅馬人毀滅。

en: King Ahasuerus, who rules 127 provinces from Susa, gives a great banquet; Queen Vashti refuses to come at his command and is removed.
Young women are gathered to the palace, among them Esther, an orphan brought up by her cousin Mordecai, a Jew.
The king loves Esther more than all the others and makes her queen, but she does not tell anyone her people.
Mordecai learns of a plot to kill the king; Esther tells the king, and it is written in the royal chronicles.
Haman is promoted; Mordecai will not bow to him, so Haman plans to destroy all the Jews.
Lots (pur) are cast, and a law goes out in the king's name to kill the Jews on the thirteenth day of Adar.
Mordecai urges Esther to plead with the king; she asks the Jews to fast three days and says, "If I perish, I perish."
zh: 亞哈隨魯王在書珊統治一百二十七個省，大擺筵席；瓦實提王后不肯奉召前來，被廢。
許多少女被招進王宮，其中有以斯帖。她是孤女，由堂兄猶太人末底改撫養。
王愛以斯帖過於眾女子，立她為王后，但她沒有說出自己的種族。
末底改得知有人謀害王，以斯帖告訴王，這事記在王的史冊上。
哈曼得到提拔；末底改不向他跪拜，哈曼就要滅絕所有猶太人。
有人抽普珥，就是抽籤；一道以王的名義發出的法令，定在亞達月十三日殺滅猶太人。
末底改催以斯帖去求王；她請猶太人禁食三天，說：「我若死，就死吧！」

about.en: Saul captures Agag, king of the Amalekites
about.zh: 掃羅生擒亞瑪力王亞甲

about.en: An accusation against Judah in Ahasuerus's reign
about.zh: 亞哈隨魯在位時有人控告猶大

about.en: Nehemiah also serves the king in the citadel of Susa
about.zh: 尼希米也在書珊城堡服事王

en: Ahasuerus is generally identified with Xerxes I, king of Persia about 486 to 465 BC.
Susa lies at modern Shush in southwestern Iran; French excavations uncovered the great palace and audience hall built by Darius I.
The Persian Empire then reached from the Indus valley to Cush, the land south of Egypt in modern Sudan.
Many Jews stayed in Babylonia and Persia after the return; Esther tells of Jews living in every province of the empire.
zh: 亞哈隨魯一般認為就是薛西一世，約在公元前486至465年作波斯王。
書珊在今日伊朗西南部的蘇薩；法國考古隊在那裏發掘出大利烏一世建造的宮殿和大殿。
那時波斯帝國從印度河流域伸展到古實，就是埃及以南、今日蘇丹一帶。
歸回以後，仍有許多猶太人留在巴比倫和波斯；以斯帖記記載猶太人住在帝國各省。

title.en: God saves his people through Esther
title.zh: 神藉以斯帖拯救他的子民

en: On the third day Esther stands in the inner court; the king holds out his gold scepter and she invites him and Haman to a banquet.
Haman has a pole fifty cubits high made, to hang Mordecai on it.
That night the king cannot sleep, reads in the chronicles how Mordecai saved him, and has Haman lead Mordecai through the city in honor.
At the second banquet Esther tells the king that she and her people have been sold to be destroyed, and names Haman.
Haman is hanged on the pole he made for Mordecai.
Mordecai writes a new order in the king's name, allowing the Jews to gather and defend their lives.
On the thirteenth of Adar the Jews overcome their enemies; Mordecai and Esther establish the days of Purim, to be kept every year.
zh: 第三天，以斯帖站在內院；王向她伸出金杖，她就請王和哈曼赴她預備的筵席。
哈曼叫人做了一根五十肘高的木柱，要把末底改掛在上面。
那夜王睡不着，讀史冊時看見末底改曾救了他，就叫哈曼領末底改在城中遊行，給他尊榮。
第二次筵席上，以斯帖告訴王，她和她的同胞被賣，要被滅絕，並指出哈曼。
哈曼被掛在他為末底改預備的木柱上。
末底改以王的名義另寫諭令，准許猶太人聚集，保護自己的性命。
亞達月十三日，猶太人勝過仇敵；末底改和以斯帖定下普珥日，每年遵守。

about.en: He digs a pit and falls into the hole he made
about.zh: 挖坑的人自己掉進坑裏

about.en: Whoever digs a pit will fall into it
about.zh: 挖坑的必掉在其中

about.en: Jesus at another later festival, the Festival of Dedication
about.zh: 耶穌在另一個後起的節期修殿節

en: Jews keep Purim on the fourteenth of Adar (in February or March), and on the fifteenth in Jerusalem, as walled Susa did.
At Purim the whole book of Esther is read aloud from a scroll, and people send gifts of food to one another, as in Esther 9:22.
The Hebrew book of Esther never names God; later Greek versions added prayers that do.
A Persian king's signet ring sealed his laws; seals and impressions of Persian kings have been found at Persepolis and elsewhere.
zh: 猶太人在亞達月十四日（二月或三月）守普珥日；耶路撒冷則在十五日守，如同有城牆的書珊。
普珥日要從書卷中把整卷以斯帖記朗讀出來，人們又彼此送食物，如以斯帖記9章22節所記。
希伯來文的以斯帖記沒有提到神的名；後來的希臘文版本加上了提到神的禱文。
波斯王用印戒蓋印頒佈法令；在波斯波利斯等地都出土了波斯王的印章和印痕。

en: In the reign of Artaxerxes, Ezra, a priest descended from Aaron and a scribe skilled in the Law of Moses, comes up from Babylon.
Ezra has set his heart to study the Law of the LORD, to do it, and to teach it in Israel.
Artaxerxes gives Ezra a letter: he may take silver and gold for the temple, appoint judges and teach the laws of his God.
Ezra blesses the LORD for putting this into the king's heart, and gathers leaders to go with him.
By the river Ahava, Ezra proclaims a fast, ashamed to ask the king for soldiers, and God answers their prayer.
The hand of God protects them on the journey; after four months they reach Jerusalem.
zh: 亞達薛西在位時，以斯拉從巴比倫上來。他是亞倫後裔的祭司，是精通摩西律法的經學家。
以斯拉立定心志，研究耶和華的律法，遵行律法，又在以色列中教導。
亞達薛西給以斯拉一封信：准他帶金銀獻給聖殿，設立審判官，並教導他神的律法。
以斯拉稱頌耶和華，因為他使王起了這心意；他就召集首領與他同去。
在亞哈瓦河邊，以斯拉宣告禁食；他不好意思求王派兵保護，神就應允他們的禱告。
神的手保護他們一路平安；走了四個月，他們到了耶路撒冷。

about.en: Ezra reads the Law to all the people
about.zh: 以斯拉向眾民宣讀律法

about.en: Moses commands the Law to be read to all Israel
about.zh: 摩西吩咐向以色列眾人宣讀律法

about.en: The next part: Ezra mourns over the people's unfaithfulness
about.zh: 接下來：以斯拉為百姓的不忠悲傷

en: If the king is Artaxerxes I, Ezra came in 458 BC, as most hold; some think of Artaxerxes II and date it to 398 BC.
The route from Babylon to Jerusalem followed the Euphrates north and then south through Syria, about 1,400 km (900 miles).
Ezra 7:12-26, the king's letter, is in Aramaic; a talent of silver weighed about 34 kg (75 pounds).
zh: 如果那王是亞達薛西一世，以斯拉便是在公元前458年來的，多數學者這樣看；也有人認為是亞達薛西二世，定在公元前398年。
從巴比倫到耶路撒冷的路線沿伯拉河北上，再經敘利亞南下，約一千四百公里。
以斯拉記7章12至26節，就是王的信，用亞蘭文寫成；一他連得銀子約重三十四公斤。

en: In Susa, Nehemiah hears that Jerusalem's wall is broken down and its gates burned; he weeps, fasts and prays.
Nehemiah is cupbearer to King Artaxerxes; when the king asks why he is sad, he prays and asks to be sent to rebuild the city.
The king sends him with letters to the governors and for timber from the king's forest.
Nehemiah tells the people, "Let us rebuild the wall of Jerusalem"; they answer, "Let us get up and build!"
Sanballat, Tobiah and Geshem mock them, then plot to attack; the people pray and set a guard day and night.
Half of Nehemiah's men work while half hold weapons; builders work with one hand and hold a weapon with the other.
The wall is finished on the twenty-fifth of Elul, in fifty-two days, and the nations around know God has done this.
zh: 尼希米在書珊聽說耶路撒冷的城牆崩塌，城門被火焚燒；他就哭泣、禁食、禱告。
尼希米是亞達薛西王的酒政；王問他為何愁眉不展，他向神禱告，然後求王差他去重建那城。
王差他去，給他信件交給各省長，又准他從王的林園取木材。
尼希米對百姓說：「我們來重建耶路撒冷的城牆吧！」他們說：「我們起來建造吧！」
參巴拉、多比雅和基善嘲笑他們，又謀劃來攻擊；百姓禱告，晝夜派人看守。
尼希米的僕人一半做工，一半拿兵器；建造的人一隻手做工，一隻手拿着兵器。
以祿月二十五日，城牆完工，共用了五十二天；四圍的列國都知道這工是神成就的。

about.en: Earlier, Artaxerxes had stopped work on the city
about.zh: 早先亞達薛西曾下令停止建城

about.en: Unless the LORD builds the house and guards the city
about.zh: 若不是耶和華建造房屋、看守城池

about.en: The next part: the dedication of the wall
about.zh: 接下來：城牆的奉獻禮

en: The twentieth year of Artaxerxes I was about 445 BC; Elul, when the wall was finished, falls in August or September.
A cupbearer tasted and served the king's wine; he was a trusted official with daily access to the king.
Letters from Elephantine in Egypt, about 407 BC, mention "Sanballat governor of Samaria" and his sons.
zh: 亞達薛西一世第二十年約是公元前445年；城牆完工的以祿月，約在八月或九月。
酒政負責試酒，並把酒遞給王；他是王所信任的官員，天天可以見王。
在埃及象島出土、約公元前407年的書信，提到「撒瑪利亞省長參巴拉」和他的兒子。

en: On the first day of the seventh month, all the people gather in the square before the Water Gate and ask Ezra to bring the Law.
Standing on a wooden platform, Ezra reads from daybreak until midday, and all the people listen closely.
When Ezra opens the book the people stand; he blesses the LORD, and they answer "Amen! Amen!" and bow down.
The Levites read clearly and give the sense, so that the people understand what is read.
The people weep; Nehemiah and Ezra say the day is holy, and "the joy of the LORD is your strength."
They find in the Law the Festival of Shelters, make shelters of branches and live in them for seven days.
Every day of the festival Ezra reads from the book of the Law, and there is very great joy.
zh: 七月初一，眾民聚集在水門前的廣場，請以斯拉把律法書帶來。
以斯拉站在木臺上，從清早讀到中午，眾民都留心聽。
以斯拉一打開書卷，眾民就站起來；他稱頌耶和華，眾民回應：「阿們！阿們！」又俯伏敬拜。
利未人清楚地宣讀，講解意思，使百姓明白所讀的。
眾民都哭了；尼希米和以斯拉說今天是聖日，「因靠耶和華而得的喜樂是你們的力量」。
他們在律法上看到住棚節，就用樹枝搭棚，住在棚裏七天。
節期中以斯拉天天宣讀律法書，眾人都非常喜樂。

about.en: The Law to be read at the Festival of Shelters
about.zh: 在住棚節宣讀律法

about.en: The command to live in shelters for seven days
about.zh: 吩咐住在棚裏七天

about.en: Jesus reads the scroll of Isaiah in the synagogue
about.zh: 耶穌在會堂裏讀以賽亞書

about.en: The next part: the people confess their sins
about.zh: 接下來：百姓認罪

en: The Water Gate was on the east side of the city, toward the Gihon Spring in the Kidron Valley.
The Festival of Shelters (Sukkot) falls in September or October; Jews still build shelters of branches for it today.
Jewish tradition links the Levites' "giving the sense" to the later practice of reading Scripture with an Aramaic translation (Targum).
zh: 水門在城的東面，朝向汲淪谷的基訓泉。
住棚節在九月或十月；今日猶太人仍在這節期用樹枝搭棚。
猶太傳統把利未人「講解意思」與後來讀經時附上亞蘭文譯本（他爾根）的做法聯繫起來。

en: The word of the LORD comes against Damascus, Tyre and Sidon, and the cities of the Philistines.
The LORD says he will camp around his house as a guard, and no oppressor will overrun them again.
Daughter Zion is told to rejoice: her king is coming, righteous and victorious, humble and riding on a donkey's colt.
He will cut off the chariot and the war horse, proclaim peace to the nations, and rule from sea to sea.
Because of the blood of the covenant, the LORD will set prisoners free from the waterless pit.
On that day the LORD will save his people like a flock; they will sparkle like jewels in a crown.
zh: 耶和華的話攻擊大馬色、推羅、西頓和非利士人的城。
耶和華說他要在他的殿四圍安營保護，欺壓的人必不再經過。
錫安的女兒要大大喜樂：她的王來了，他公義、得勝、謙卑，騎着驢駒。
他要除滅戰車和戰馬，向列國宣講和平，他的統治從這海直到那海。
因立約的血，耶和華要從無水的坑中釋放被囚的人。
到那日，耶和華要拯救他的子民如同羊群；他們要像冠冕上的寶石閃耀。

about.en: Jesus rides into Jerusalem on a donkey
about.zh: 耶穌騎驢進耶路撒冷

about.en: The crowd with palm branches; Zechariah 9:9 quoted
about.zh: 群眾拿棕樹枝迎接，引用撒迦利亞書9章9節

about.en: Solomon rides King David's mule to be anointed king
about.zh: 所羅門騎大衛王的騾子去受膏作王

en: Zechariah began to prophesy in 520 BC, with Haggai; chapters 9 to 14 carry no dates, and many scholars date them later.
Kings of Israel rode mules and donkeys in peace; chariots and war horses were the strength of armies.
Tyre's island fortress, named in 9:3-4, fell to Alexander the Great in 332 BC after a siege of about seven months.
zh: 撒迦利亞在公元前520年與哈該一同開始說預言；9至14章沒有記日期，許多學者認為較晚寫成。
以色列的王在太平時騎騾子和驢；戰車和戰馬是軍隊的力量。
9章3至4節提到的推羅島上堡壘，在公元前332年被亞歷山大大帝圍攻約七個月後攻陷。

en: The LORD says he is sending his messenger to prepare the way before him.
Then the Lord whom they seek will suddenly come to his temple, the messenger of the covenant.
No one can endure the day of his coming: he is like a refiner's fire and launderers' soap, and will purify the sons of Levi.
The day is coming, burning like an oven, when the arrogant and evildoers will be like stubble.
For those who fear the LORD's name, the sun of righteousness will rise with healing in its wings.
They are told to remember the Law of Moses given at Horeb.
The LORD will send Elijah the prophet before his great day, to turn the hearts of fathers and children to each other.
zh: 耶和華說，他要差遣他的使者，在他前面預備道路。
他們所尋求的主，就是立約的使者，必忽然進入他的殿。
他來的日子誰能當得起呢？他像煉金之人的火，像漂布之人的鹼，要潔淨利未的子孫。
那日子要來，燒起來如同火爐，狂傲的和作惡的都要像碎秸。
敬畏耶和華名的人，必有公義的太陽升起，它的翅膀有醫治的能力。
他們要記得在何烈山賜下的摩西律法。
在耶和華的大日子來到以前，他要差遣以利亞先知，使父親和兒女的心彼此回轉。

about.en: Mark begins with Malachi's messenger and John the Baptist
about.zh: 馬可福音以瑪拉基的使者和施洗的約翰開始

about.en: John will go in the spirit and power of Elijah
about.zh: 約翰必有以利亞的心志和能力

about.en: Jesus says John is the messenger and the Elijah to come
about.zh: 耶穌說約翰就是那使者，是那要來的以利亞

about.en: Jesus says Elijah has already come
about.zh: 耶穌說以利亞已經來了

en: The name Malachi means "my messenger"; the book is usually dated to the 400s BC, near the time of Ezra and Nehemiah.
Malachi 3:19-24 in this Bible is chapter 4 in most English Bibles.
Malachi is the last book of the Old Testament in Christian Bibles; the Hebrew Bible ends with Chronicles.
zh: 瑪拉基這名字的意思是「我的使者」；這卷書一般定在公元前五世紀，接近以斯拉和尼希米的時代。
本站的瑪拉基書3章19至24節，在多數英文聖經和和合本是第4章。
在基督教的聖經裏，瑪拉基書是舊約最後一卷；希伯來聖經則以歷代志作結。

title.zh: 彌迦：出於伯利恆的統治者

en: Bethlehem Ephrathah is too small to be among the clans of Judah.
Yet from Bethlehem one will come out to be ruler in Israel, whose origins are from of old, from ancient days.
God will give his people up until she who is in labor has given birth; then the rest of his brothers will return.
He will stand and shepherd his flock in the strength and majesty of the name of the LORD his God.
His people will live secure, for he will be great to the ends of the earth.
He will be their peace, and he will rescue them from Assyria.
zh: 伯利恆‧以法他在猶大的宗族中弱小。
卻必有一位從伯利恆出來，作以色列的統治者；他的根源從太古、從亙古就有。
神必把他的子民交出，直到那臨產的婦人生下孩子；然後他其餘的弟兄必歸回。
他必站立，靠耶和華的能力和他神之名的威嚴，牧養他的羊群。
他的子民必安然居住，因為他必為大，直到地極。
他必作他們的平安，救他們脫離亞述。

about.en: The chief priests quote Micah: the Messiah is born in Bethlehem
about.zh: 祭司長引用彌迦書：基督生在伯利恆

about.en: The crowd: the Messiah comes from David's village, Bethlehem
about.zh: 眾人說：基督出於大衛的村莊伯利恆

about.en: David, son of Jesse the Ephrathite from Bethlehem
about.zh: 大衛是伯利恆以法他人耶西的兒子

about.en: A child born, a son given, on David's throne
about.zh: 有一嬰孩為我們而生，坐大衛的王位

en: Micah of Moresheth prophesied in the days of Jotham, Ahaz and Hezekiah, in the late 700s BC, at the same time as Isaiah.
Bethlehem lies about 9 km (6 miles) south of Jerusalem; Ephrathah was an old name for it or its clan (Genesis 35:19).
Micah 5:1 in this Bible is 5:2 in most English Bibles.
zh: 摩利沙人彌迦在約坦、亞哈斯、希西家年間說預言，約在公元前八世紀末，與以賽亞同時。
伯利恆在耶路撒冷以南約九公里；以法他是它或當地宗族的古名（創世記35章19節）。
本站的彌迦書5章1節，在多數英文聖經和和合本是5章2節。

en: In a vision Daniel sees a ram with two horns charging west, north and south, and no beast can stand before it.
A male goat with one great horn comes from the west, strikes the ram and breaks its two horns.
The great horn is broken, and four horns come up in its place; from one grows a small horn.
The small horn takes away the regular offering and throws down the place of the sanctuary.
Gabriel explains: the ram is the kings of Media and Persia, and the goat is the king of Greece.
Paul writes that when the fullness of time had come, God sent his Son, born of a woman, born under the Law.
zh: 但以理在異象中看見一隻有兩角的公綿羊，向西、向北、向南抵觸，沒有獸能在牠面前站立。
一隻有一個大角的公山羊從西方來，撞倒公綿羊，折斷牠的兩角。
那大角折斷了，在原處長出四個角；其中一角又長出一個小角。
那小角除掉了常獻的祭，推倒了聖所。
加百列解釋：公綿羊是米底亞和波斯的諸王，公山羊是希臘王。
保羅寫道：到了時候滿足，神就差遣他的兒子，為女子所生，生在律法以下。

about.en: Forces will profane the sanctuary and stop the offering
about.zh: 有軍隊要褻瀆聖所，除掉常獻的祭

about.en: Jesus in the temple at the Festival of Dedication
about.zh: 耶穌在修殿節時在聖殿裏

about.en: Jesus: the time has come, the kingdom of God has come near
about.zh: 耶穌說：日期滿了，神的國近了

en: About 400 years separate Malachi from the birth of Jesus; Alexander the Great conquered the Persian Empire in 334 to 331 BC.
After Alexander died in 323 BC, his generals divided his empire; the Ptolemies of Egypt and then the Seleucids of Syria ruled Judea.
The Seleucid king Antiochus IV defiled the temple in 167 BC; the Maccabees rededicated it in 164 BC, remembered at Hanukkah, the Festival of Dedication.
The Roman general Pompey took Jerusalem in 63 BC; Rome made Herod the Great king of Judea, and he ruled from 37 to 4 BC.
zh: 從瑪拉基到耶穌降生約有四百年；亞歷山大大帝在公元前334至331年征服波斯帝國。
亞歷山大在公元前323年去世後，他的將領瓜分帝國；埃及的多利買王朝和後來敘利亞的西流基王朝先後統治猶太地。
西流基王安提阿古四世在公元前167年污穢聖殿；馬加比家族在公元前164年重新奉獻聖殿，猶太人在修殿節（光明節）記念這事。
羅馬將軍龐培在公元前63年攻取耶路撒冷；羅馬立大希律作猶太王，他在公元前37至4年在位。

title.en: The angel's announcements: John and Jesus

en: Zechariah, a priest, and his wife Elizabeth are righteous but childless, and both are old.
While Zechariah burns incense in the sanctuary, an angel says Elizabeth will bear a son, John, who will go ahead in the spirit and power of Elijah.
Zechariah asks how he can be sure; the angel, Gabriel, says he will be unable to speak until it happens.
In the sixth month Gabriel is sent to Mary in Nazareth, a virgin engaged to Joseph, of the house of David.
Gabriel says she will bear a son named Jesus, the Son of the Most High, whose kingdom will never end.
Mary says, "Here I am, the Lord's servant. Let it happen to me as you have said."
Elizabeth gives birth; Zechariah writes, "His name is John," and at once he can speak and praises God.
zh: 祭司撒迦利亞和他的妻子伊利莎白都是義人，卻沒有孩子，兩人年紀都老了。
撒迦利亞在聖所燒香時，天使說伊利莎白要生一個兒子，名叫約翰，他要有以利亞的心志和能力，走在主前面。
撒迦利亞問他怎能確定；天使加百列說，他要啞巴不能說話，直到這事成就。
第六個月，加百列被差到拿撒勒，到一個童女馬利亞那裏；她已許配給大衛家族的約瑟。
加百列說她要生一個兒子，起名叫耶穌，他要稱為至高者的兒子，他的國沒有窮盡。
馬利亞說：「我是主的使女，願照你的話成就在我身上。」
伊利莎白生了兒子；撒迦利亞寫上「他的名字是約翰」，口立刻開了，讚美神。

about.en: God will send Elijah to turn fathers' hearts to their children
about.zh: 神要差遣以利亞使父親的心轉向兒女

about.en: The sign of a son called Immanuel
about.zh: 名叫以馬內利的兒子的兆頭

about.en: Hannah's song, which Mary's song in Luke 1 echoes
about.zh: 哈拿的禱告，路加福音1章馬利亞之歌與它相似

about.en: An angel speaks to Joseph in a dream
about.zh: 天使在夢中向約瑟說話

en: The priests were divided into 24 divisions; Abijah's was the eighth (1 Chronicles 24:10), and each served in the temple in turn for a week.
Incense was burned every morning and evening on the gold altar in the Holy Place; the priest was chosen by lot, and later Jewish writings say none did it twice.
Nazareth was a small village in the hills of Galilee, about 100 km (65 miles) north of Jerusalem.
Herod the Great ruled Judea from 37 to 4 BC.
zh: 祭司分為二十四班；亞比雅班是第八班（歷代志上24章10節），各班輪流在聖殿供職一週。
每天早晚在聖所的金香壇上燒香；這差事由抽籤決定；後來的猶太文獻說，沒有祭司能做第二次。
拿撒勒是加利利山區的小村莊，在耶路撒冷以北約一百公里。
大希律在公元前37至4年統治猶太地。
